questions.stem: For all x > 0, which of the following expressions is equivalent to (x^(3/2))^4 · x^(−1) ?
A community garden charges a one-time membership fee of $35 plus $12 per month to rent a plot. Dana can spend at most $150 in total. What is the greatest whole number of months Dana can rent a plot?

questions.subskill: Systems of linear equations: number of solutions
questions.stem:
In the system of equations below, k is a constant.
4x − 6y = 10
6x + ky = 15
For what value of k does the system have infinitely many solutions (x, y) ?
Let f(x) = x² − 4 and g(x) = 3x + 1. What is the value of g(f(3)) ?

Points A and B lie on a circle with center O. The length of minor arc AB is 4π centimeters, and the area of sector AOB (bounded by radii OA and OB and minor arc AB) is 24π square centimeters. What is the radius of the circle, in centimeters?
The mean of a list of 6 numbers is 15. After one number is removed from the list, the mean of the remaining 5 numbers is 13. What number was removed?
The price of a jacket is increased by 20%. Later, the increased price is decreased by 25%. The final price is what percent of the original price?

questions.subskill: Volume and rates with unit conversion
questions.stem: A rectangular tank is 2 meters long, 1.5 meters wide, and 1.2 meters tall. It currently holds water to a depth of 0.4 meter. Water is pumped in at a constant rate of 36 liters per minute. To the nearest minute, how many minutes will it take for the water level to reach 0.3 meter below the top of the tank? (1 cubic meter = 1,000 liters)
For i = √(−1), which of the following is equal to (3 − 2i)(1 + 4i) ?
What is the sum of the two solutions of the equation 2x² − 7x − 15 = 0 ?
What is the solution set of the equation x/(x − 2) + 1 = 2/(x − 2) ?

The table below shows four values of a linear function f.
x: 1, 2, 3, 4
f(x): 7, 10, 13, 16
Which of the following defines f ?

The number of registered users of a new app t weeks after launch is modeled by U(t) = 1,200(2)^(t/5). According to the model, to the nearest tenth of a week, how many weeks after launch will the app have 60,000 registered users?
In the standard (x,y) coordinate plane, the endpoints of a diameter of a circle are (−3, 4) and (5, −2). Which of the following is an equation of the circle?

questions.subskill: Similar solids: area and volume ratios
questions.stem: Two cylindrical cups are similar in shape. The total surface area of the larger cup is 9/4 times the total surface area of the smaller cup. If the smaller cup holds 160 milliliters, how many milliliters does the larger cup hold?

questions.subskill: Probability of 'at least one' with combinations
questions.stem: A club has 5 juniors and 7 seniors. Three members of the club are chosen at random to form a committee. What is the probability that the committee includes at least 1 junior?

Fifteen students reported how many books they read over the summer. The results are shown below.
Number of books: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4
Number of students: 2, 4, 5, 3, 1
What is the median number of books read by these 15 students?

Printer P prints 18 pages every 45 seconds, and printer Q prints 3 pages every 10 seconds. Working at the same time at these constant rates, about how many minutes will the two printers take to print a total of 300 pages? (Round to the nearest minute.)
What is the value of (6.0 × 10⁵)(4.0 × 10⁻²) ÷ (8.0 × 10¹) ?

questions.subskill: Systems of linear equations in context
questions.stem: A school theater sold 340 tickets for a play. Adult tickets cost $12 each, and student tickets cost $8 each. Total ticket sales were $3,480. How many adult tickets were sold?
The function g is defined by g(x) = f(x + 2) − 5. The point (3, 7) lies on the graph of y = f(x). Which of the following points must lie on the graph of y = g(x) ?
The graph of the quadratic function f in the standard (x,y) coordinate plane passes through the points (0, 5) and (4, 5), and the maximum value of f is 9. What is the value of f(5) ?
In triangle PQR, the measure of ∠R is 40°, and the measure of ∠P is 20° greater than the measure of ∠Q. What is the measure of ∠P ?
An equilateral triangle has a perimeter of 36 centimeters. What is the area of the triangle, in square centimeters?

questions.subskill: Conditional probability from a two-way table
questions.stem:
A survey asked 200 students whether they prefer online or in-person tutoring. The results are summarized below.
Juniors: 48 online, 52 in-person (100 total)
Seniors: 66 online, 34 in-person (100 total)
All students: 114 online, 86 in-person (200 total)
One of the students who prefer online tutoring is selected at random. What is the probability that the selected student is a senior?
A 24-ounce jar of Brand A peanut butter costs $4.80, and a 32-ounce jar of Brand B peanut butter costs $5.76. How many cents less per ounce does Brand B cost than Brand A?
During a sale, every bicycle helmet in a store is discounted 15% off its original price. A helmet's sale price is $68.00. What was its original price?
A chemist has 6 liters of a solution that is 10% acid by volume. How many liters of a solution that is 40% acid by volume must be added to obtain a mixture that is 20% acid by volume?
Vectors u = ⟨3, −4⟩ and v = ⟨−1, 2⟩ are given in component form. What is the magnitude of the vector 2u − v ?
What value of x satisfies the equation (x − 4)/3 = (x + 2)/5 ?
What is the set of all real solutions of the equation √(2x + 7) = x + 2 ?
The function f is defined by f(x) = √(x − 3) + 1 for all real numbers x for which f(x) is a real number. Which of the following values is NOT in the domain of f ?
What is the period of the function y = 3 sin(4x) + 1 ?

questions.subskill: Perpendicular lines in the coordinate plane
questions.stem: In the standard (x,y) coordinate plane, line ℓ passes through the point (1, 2) and is perpendicular to the line 3x − 4y = 8. At what point does line ℓ intersect the y-axis?

A square is inscribed in a circle of radius 6 inches, so that all 4 vertices of the square lie on the circle. What is the area, in square inches, of the region inside the circle but outside the square?

A 4-digit access code uses the digits 0 through 9, and no digit may appear more than once in a code. The first digit must be odd, and the last digit must be even. How many different access codes are possible?
On a map, 1.5 inches represents 20 miles. Two towns are 4.2 inches apart on the map. What is the actual distance between the towns, in miles?

A closed cylindrical water tank has a radius of 4 feet and a height of 9 feet. The entire outside surface, including the top and bottom, will be painted. Each quart of paint covers 40 square feet, and paint is sold only in whole quarts. What is the least number of quarts that must be bought?
Which of the following numbers is between 3/8 and 5/12 ?

Shuttle A leaves a station every 12 minutes, and Shuttle B leaves the same station every 18 minutes. Both shuttles leave the station at 7:00 a.m. What is the next time after 7:00 a.m. that both shuttles leave the station at the same time?

questions.subskill: Exponential equations with a common base
questions.stem: What value of x satisfies the equation 4^(x + 1) = 8^(x − 1) ?
For the function f(x) = x² − 3x, what is the average rate of change of f from x = 1 to x = 5 ?
For a positive number b ≠ 1, log_b 2 = p and log_b 3 = q. Which of the following expressions is equal to log_b (18/b) ?

A grain silo is shaped like a right circular cylinder with a hemisphere on top. The cylinder and the hemisphere each have a radius of 5 meters, and the cylinder is 12 meters tall. What is the total volume of the silo, in cubic meters? (The volume of a sphere of radius r is (4/3)πr³.)

In triangle ABC, point D lies on side AB and point E lies on side AC so that segment DE is parallel to side BC. AD = 6 and DB = 4. The area of triangle ADE is 54 square units. What is the area, in square units, of quadrilateral DBCE?

A carnival game costs $2 to play. On each play, a player wins a $10 prize with probability 0.1, wins a $4 prize with probability 0.2, and wins nothing otherwise. What is the expected net gain for a player per play, taking the cost to play into account?
Each of the following data sets has a mean of 5. Which data set has the greatest standard deviation?

On a 420-mile trip, Lena drove 300 miles on highways and the remaining miles in cities. Her car averaged 30 miles per gallon on highways and 20 miles per gallon in cities. Gasoline cost $3.60 per gallon. What was the total cost of the gasoline used on the trip?
If x + 1/x = 5, what is the value of x² + 1/x² ?
A store sells pens only in packs of 3 and packs of 5. Jamal bought exactly 31 pens. What is the greatest number of packs Jamal could have bought?
For all values of x for which the expression is defined, (x² − 9)/(x² + x − 6) is equivalent to which of the following?
A function f is defined for all nonnegative integers n by f(0) = 3 and f(n + 1) = 2f(n) − 1. What is the value of f(4) ?

A ball is thrown upward from a balcony. Its height above the ground, in meters, t seconds after it is thrown is modeled by h(t) = −5t² + 20t + 1.75. According to the model, for how many seconds is the ball more than 16.75 meters above the ground?

figure.description: Circle with center O, radius 5; external point P with OP = 13; tangent segments PT and PS; chord TS. Not needed to solve; for production only.

questions.stem: Point P is 13 units from the center O of a circle that has a radius of 5 units. The two lines through P that are tangent to the circle touch the circle at points T and S. What is the length, in units, of segment TS ?

A wheelchair ramp makes a 6° angle with the level ground and rises a vertical distance of 1.2 meters from bottom to top. Which of the following expressions gives the length, in meters, of the ramp's sloped surface?
A point is selected at random from the interior of a square with side length 10 centimeters. What is the probability that the point is within 2 centimeters of at least one side of the square?

An inflow pipe can fill an empty tank in 6 hours, and a drain can empty a full tank in 9 hours. The tank is currently 1/3 full. If the inflow pipe and the drain are both open, how many hours will it take for the tank to become completely full?

In a club, the ratio of boys to girls is 3:5. After 6 more boys join the club and no members leave, the club has the same number of boys as girls. How many members did the club have before the 6 boys joined?
Consider the positive integers n from 1 through 9 for which n² has exactly 3 positive divisors. What is the sum of all such values of n ?
What is the value of 27^(−2/3) ?
The equation x² − 6x + c = 0, where c is a constant, has two different real solutions, and both solutions are greater than 1. Which of the following describes all possible values of c ?

questions.subskill: Linear models from two data points
questions.stem: A candle burns down at a constant rate. Two hours after it is lit, the candle is 17 centimeters tall. Five hours after it is lit, it is 9.5 centimeters tall. How many hours after it is lit will the candle burn down completely?
The function f is defined by f(x) = (3x + 1)/(x − 2) for all x ≠ 2. The function f has an inverse function, f⁻¹. For which value of x is f⁻¹(x) undefined?
The function g is defined by g(x) = 2^x. Which of the following is equal to g(x + 3) for all real numbers x ?
Triangle ABC is inscribed in a circle, and side AB is a diameter of the circle. The measure of ∠BAC is 28°. What is the measure of minor arc BC ?

A list of 5 positive integers has a median of 8, a mean of 7, and a mode of 10. No other value appears in the list as often as 10 does. How many different lists of 5 numbers, written in order from least to greatest, satisfy all of these conditions?
A rectangular lawn measures 30 feet by 45 feet. It will be covered completely with sod sold in rolls that each cover 10 square yards. What is the least number of rolls needed? (1 yard = 3 feet)

A cyclist rides 12 kilometers up a hill at an average speed of 8 kilometers per hour and then rides the same 12 kilometers back down at an average speed of 24 kilometers per hour. What is the cyclist's average speed, in kilometers per hour, for the entire 24-kilometer trip?
For i = √(−1), what is the value of the sum i + i² + i³ + i⁴ + … + i⁵⁰ ?
The polynomial p(x) = x³ + kx² − 4x + 6, where k is a constant, leaves a remainder of 18 when it is divided by x − 2. What is the remainder when p(x) is divided by x + 1 ?
Angle θ satisfies π < θ < 3π/2, and sin θ = −3/5. What is the value of sin(2θ) ? (Use the identity sin(2θ) = 2 sin θ cos θ.)

The functions f and g are defined only for x = 1, 2, 3 and 4, as shown below.
x: 1, 2, 3, 4
f(x): 3, 4, 1, 2
g(x): 2, 1, 4, 3
For how many of these 4 values of x is f(g(x)) = g(f(x)) ?

questions.subskill: Altitude via area in the coordinate plane
questions.stem: In the standard (x,y) coordinate plane, triangle PQR has vertices P(0, 0), Q(8, 0) and R(2, 6). What is the length of the altitude from Q to side PR ?
The distance between opposite corners of a cube, measured through the inside of the cube, is 6√3 centimeters. What is the volume of the cube, in cubic centimeters?

questions.subskill: Conditional probability with a reduced sample space
questions.stem: Two fair six-sided dice, each numbered 1 through 6, are rolled. Given that the sum of the two numbers rolled is 8, what is the probability that at least one of the dice shows a 6 ?

A data set has a mean of 12 and a standard deviation of 4. Each value in the data set is multiplied by 3, and then 5 is added to each result. What are the mean and the standard deviation of the new data set?
A tank holds 40 liters of salt water that is 15% salt by volume. Water (but no salt) evaporates until the solution is 25% salt by volume. How many liters of water evaporated?

Ana starts walking along a trail at 9:00 a.m. at a constant 4 miles per hour. Ben starts from the same point at 9:30 a.m. and bikes along the same trail in the same direction at a constant 10 miles per hour. At what time does Ben catch up to Ana?
What is the value of |3 − 8| + |−4| ?
What value of x satisfies 3(x − 2) = 2x + 5 ?
What is the set of all real solutions of the equation 4^x − 3 · 2^x − 4 = 0 ?

On a floor plan, 1 inch represents 4 feet. A rectangular room on the plan measures 3.5 inches by 5 inches. Flooring for the room costs $6 per square foot. What is the cost of flooring for the whole room?
The function f is defined by f(x) = x² − 6x + 11 for 0 ≤ x ≤ 4. What is the range of f ?
Two lines intersect at a point. One of the angles formed measures (3x + 10)°, and the angle vertical to it measures (5x − 30)°. What is the value of x ?

figure.description: Right triangle ABC, right angle at C, altitude CD to hypotenuse AB with AD = 4, DB = 9. Optional for production.

questions.stem: In right triangle ABC, ∠C is the right angle. Point D lies on hypotenuse AB so that segment CD is perpendicular to AB. If AD = 4 and DB = 9, what is the length of CD ?
A fair coin is tossed 5 times. What is the probability that it lands heads up exactly 3 times?
A 20-liter container of juice is poured into bottles that each hold 0.75 liter. How many bottles can be filled completely?
At a high school, 60% of the students take Spanish, 45% take French, and 20% take both Spanish and French. What percent of the students take Spanish but not French?
